entities.summary: Brynton Jevon Lemar is an American-born Jamaican professional basketball player for Beşiktaş Gain of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroCup. After playing four years of college basketball at UC Davis, Lemar entered the 2017 NBA draft, but was not selected in the draft's two rounds.
